limitations: The hash and length identify a private typed supervisor result, not PCAP or an independently retained native report trace.
Normal process exit and a new process were tested on hardware in this trial. Process crash, forced termination, USB interruption, sleep, power loss and vendor handback were not tested.

Medium and Quiet Auto are attended operator observations. No exact RPM or independent firmware fan-state or ownership readback was obtained. Raw0000 and raw0300 retain accessory-only unassigned semantics.

Matching completion receipts and normal-exit ordering are established by the successful supervisor result together with reviewed source. Sanitized stage receipts preserve outcomes without publishing authentication secrets or operating-system process identifiers.

Operator record timestamps are bookkeeping and may follow command completion. The typed supervisor result records baseline and all three subsequent physical confirmations as accepted during the command.

No Synapse, service action, power cycle, retry or recovery occurred during this trial. ManualPowerCycleOnly records the command's recovery acknowledgement; it does not establish that recovery happened.
Private paths, process identifiers, nonces, serials, device-instance suffixes and raw native reports are excluded. BIOS is provenance only and imposes no admission gate.
